title: Quantitative universality for products of i.i.d. random matrices
summary: Using estimates established in a previous paper, we prove quantitative universality results for cokernels of products of i.i.d. random matrices and for flags associated to k-tuples of random i.i.d. matrices, over finite local rings. In the case when the ring is a quotient of $\mathbb{Z}_p$, this gives a quantitative analogue of some previous results of Huang, Nguyen and Van Peski.
